verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for an open-finance API platform, so the axis applies. The pack has no documented export-all or account-offboarding capability, and no open-format bulk export. Paginated List endpoints (up to 1000 results per page) are only developer building blocks for pulling records, and 'Copy page as Markdown' applies to documentation pages, not customer data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
